messages:
elaine: Quick sync — after yesterday's outage we need to finalize how we communicate follow-ups to customers. Proposal: a 3-tier disclosure model + a flagging rule for recurring patterns. Thoughts?

mike: recommend 3 tiers too. Can you sketch ownership + deadlines? we should avoid committing to a timeline we can't meet.

elaine: yep. Sketch below: Public summary (short, non-technical) — within 24h; Technical addendum (sequence/timeline, impacted subsystems, mitigations) — within 72h; Full investigation package (detailed RCA, logs, long-term plan) — available on request after internal sign-off (aim <= 14 days).

sam: +1. For ownership: Draft public summary = SRE on-call (jen) to post and PR to status page. Technical addendum = primary eng lead + sam to co-author. Full package = PM + eng lead + security review.

lina: We also need a rule for "recurring pattern" language. If we detect similar incidents 2x in 30 days or 3x in 90 days, we should surface that in the technical addendum and commit to a targeted mitigation ETA and owner. That prevents surprises for customers.

mike: Lina — can you propose exact thresholds and what wording to use? e.g., "We've observed a recurring pattern" vs "potential recurrence". Language sensitivity matters for legal & sales.

lina: Draft thresholds: (A) Pattern = >=2 similar incidents in 30 days OR >=3 in 90 days. (B) If Pattern true: include a short statement in technical addendum: "We have observed a recurring pattern; immediate mitigations are in place and a medium-term remediation plan is owned by <team> with ETA ~X weeks."

jen: For public summary, keep it neutral and customer-facing. Example: "We experienced a service disruption affecting X. We restored service at T. We're investigating root causes and will share more details soon." No mention of internal tickets or blame.

elaine: Good. For status page wording we should provide a small template so on-call can paste quickly. Proposed snippet: ```Public summary: Service disruption affecting <product area> starting <time>. Impact: <customers affected>. Resolution: <what we did to restore>. Next steps: Further details to follow within 72 hours.```

sam: Where do we store the technical addendum template? Suggest a central folder in the incidents repo and a PR checklist link in the template.

elaine: Agreed. Action items: 1) jen — publish public summary within 24h (owner: jen, done by: 2412349200) 2) sam + eng lead — technical addendum draft within 72h (owner: sam, due: 2412510800) 3) PM (mike) — coordinate full package on request and confirm sign-off flow (owner: mike, due: 2413420000) 4) lina — finalize recurring-pattern thresholds and approved phrasing (owner: lina, due: 2412349800) 5) ops — add status page template to repo + link in on-call runbook (owner: elaine, due: 2412350000)

mike: Can the incident-bot auto-tag threads that meet the recurring threshold? would be great for visibility.

incident-bot: Auto-detection is possible. I'll add a cadence job to check incident similarity tags and post in thread if thresholds are hit. Will need a mapping of similarity rules from eng-ml.

lina: I'll work with eng-ml to define the similarity signature (error codes + service + time window). Target sync: tomorrow 10am PT.

jen: One more ask — for customers who request the full package, we need a standard intake form and an approval checklist (security & legal). Mike, can your team handle intake?

mike: Yes, we'll own intake + approvals. I'll publish the intake form template in the next 48h.

elaine: Cool. Let's confirm owners in this thread and we'll convert to a follow-up checklist in the action tracker. TL;DR: agreed 3-tier disclosure, recurring-pattern thresholds, owners assigned. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll create the action tracker entries after this and ping owners.

jen: I'll post the 24h public summary now and paste link when done.

incident-bot: Public summary posted to status page at 2412349100 (link: https://status.redwood.example/incident/2412348000)

mike: Received. Leaving this thread open for any edits to wording.

elaine: Closing comments in 1h unless someone objects.

lina: No objections.

sam: all good from eng.
